name: Yashasvi Jaiswal
notes: Elite powerplay pressure striker (+1.19 RAE/ball); minimal exposure in overs 16–20.

name: Sanju Samson
notes: Strong top-3 anchor and spin accelerator; peak leverage in overs 5–14.

name: Riyan Parag
notes: Sharp middle-over growth in 2024–25; positive spin match-up value at #4.

name: Dhruv Jurel
notes: Composed vs hard lengths, but lower boundary rate under steep 12+ RPO death chases.

name: Shimron Hetmyer
notes: Carries heavy death-finishing load alone; high variance without a second elite finisher.

name: Nitish Rana
notes: Useful left-handed middle-over bridge; modest pressure uplift against high pace.

name: Jofra Archer
notes: High-impact powerplay strike bowler; needs death-over workload sharing.

name: Sandeep Sharma
notes: Reliable swing & yorker execution, though speed ceiling gets tested on flat decks.

name: Wanindu Hasaranga
notes: Wicket-taking wrist spin in overs 7–15; rarely deployed inside the final three overs.

name: Maheesh Theekshana
notes: Powerplay carrom-ball control; primarily used before over 15.

name: Tushar Deshpande
notes: Takes wickets in bursts but leaks high boundary counts in overs 17–20.
